title: RWB-S8-E7006-APP: the X6 slice has no plan row for its consumed contracts, its skip-trace sources, its events, its agent dispatch, its 30-day clock or the deviation service level
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R7.3 and R9; split plan slice RWB-S8-E7006-APP; context pack S8 rwb-deviation (service row, ownership rows, Architecture v5 slides 3, 4, 5, 8 and 13, Temporal and Drools slides 5, 8 and 13); legacy RWB-E7-006; FSD S8 Deviation handling v3 A1.2, A1.4, A2.15 and Requirements served; TSD S8 Deviation handling v2 T2, T3.0, T3.1, T3.2, T4, T5.1, T5.3, T6.1 and T-A; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DEV-01, R-DEV-06, R-DEV-16, R-DEV-17, R-DEV-18, R-DEV-19, R-DEV-20 and R-UNI-12; Recovery Workbench Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 row FEAT-DVF-06
description: (1) The plan gives H = RWB-S8-E7006-CON, RWB-PLT-E1027-CON and RWB-PLT-N001-CON with C, I and X empty, while the slice consumes the rwb-case boundary and its events, the rwb-agent skip trace, the rwb-source-data contact data product and an agency answer, so four consumed rows have no plan row. (2) DP-20 is absent from the pattern set although R-DEV-06 makes the agent work the trace and the connection matrix gives S8 a Temporal and event edge to rwb-agent, so C RWB-P10-TE013-CON is not held. (3) DP-09 and DP-14 are absent although the service owns topic rwb.deviation.events.v1 and event EV-06/EV-07, so the outbox and inbox library RWB-PLT-TE006-CON is absent from the H row. (4) DP-05 is absent although the contact data and the agency facts are another owner's. (5) FSD S8 A2.15.2 names NCB, EFS and the Partner portal as integration points while TSD S8 T5.1 publishes None, and the connection matrix gives S8 no row to P2 rwb-integration or S9 rwb-partner, so the bureau and agency reads have no published interface. (6) FSD S8 A2.15.3.1 prints VR-S8-015-1 and BR-S8-015 and no rule row, so R-DEV-01, R-DEV-06, R-DEV-16, R-DEV-17, R-DEV-18, R-DEV-19, R-DEV-20 and R-UNI-12 come from the rule workbook only. (7) The deviation service level that R-DEV-20 escalates against is set with DL22 and has no published value. (8) The service is created in Arch v5 wave 2 while EP07 is W-MAP wave 4, and the plan keeps wave 4.
evidence: Split plan H/C/I/X lists; context pack service row and connection matrix row S8 (E to P3, R E to P1, T E to P10, no row to P2 or S9); FSD S8 A2.15.2 and A2.15.3.1; TSD S8 T5.1 (None); Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 DEV and UNIVERSAL rows
proposed: Keep the plan's H, C, I and X rows as given, declare the four consumed rows as class C in fact with placeholders and fakes, and record the absent DP-05, DP-09, DP-14 and DP-20 rows in the registers rather than adding a metadata value no source gives.

title: RWB-S8-E7006-CON: the skip-trace element, the consumed operation names, the agency read, the state vocabulary print and the deviation service level have no published baseline
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R7.2 and R9; split plan slice RWB-S8-E7006-CON; context pack S8 rwb-deviation; legacy RWB-E7-006; FSD S8 Deviation handling v3 A1.2, A2.15.2, A2.15.3.1, A2.15.3.3 and Screens; TSD S8 Deviation handling v2 T2, T3.0, T3.1, T3.2, T4, T5.1, T5.3, T6.1 and T-A.1; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 DEV and UNIVERSAL rows; Recovery Workbench API Specification v4 API-S8-001 and API-S8-002
description: (1) No source publishes the shape of the skip-trace request or answer, so the element, its fields and its source codes carry a placeholder. (2) No source publishes a REST operation that moves a case state, reads the timers on behalf of a stage or reads a contact data product, so every consumed operation name carries a placeholder. (3) TSD S8 T5.1 publishes None and the matrix gives S8 no row to P2 or S9, so the bureau (NCB) and agency (Partner portal) answers have neither an interface nor an owner operation. (4) TSD S8 T4 prints the DEVIATION machine but FSD S8 A2.15.3.1 prints no row for this feature, so R-DEV-16 and R-DEV-17 reach the baseline from the rule workbook only. (5) The deviation service level of the R-DEV-20 escalation is set with DL22 and has no value. (6) The two operations of the service and their elements were baselined at RWB-S8-E7001-CON, so this baseline declares no operation of its own and must reference that baseline instead of restating it.
evidence: TSD S8 T5.1 (None) and T5.3; FSD S8 A2.15.3.1 and A2.15.3.3; context pack connection matrix row S8; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DEV-16, R-DEV-17 and R-DEV-20
proposed: Publish the X6 use of the deviation element, the three state values and the two event payloads, declare the five consumed rows as consumed with placeholders and fakes, and record the absent trace element, agency read and service level as gaps rather than inventing a name or a value.
